يقترحوا (form VIII)
# يَقْتَرِحُوا (yaqtariḥū) /jaq.ta.ri.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# يُقْتَرَحُوا (yuqtaraḥū) /juq.ta.ra.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
